name: feature-scroll
purpose: The walkthrough band of a product page: a large section title over one screen per feature. From the large breakpoint up the features scroll through a sticky stack — the copy advances while the illustration stays pinned in a framed, textured stage with one small action under each step; below it the same features are a three-column grid of media tiles. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'feature-scroll', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box`, `card-grid`, `media-tile`, `illustration`, `sticky-stack`, `texture-material` and `button`.
useWhen: To walk through four to six capabilities of one product, each with a picture of its own.
avoidWhen: For three reasons with no scroll story → use `feature-tiles`.
related: sticky-stack` — the scroll engine the large layout runs on.
media-tile` — the cell the small layout renders each feature with.
bestPractices: Four to six items; the stack needs enough steps to earn the scroll.
Give every item an `illustration`; it is the pinned picture on large screens and the tile media on small ones.
Keep `action` to a short label such as "Docs" — it sits under the step copy at the small size.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the large section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: items
props.doc: The features, in order; each is `{ title, description, illustration, action? }` where `illustration` is a registry name and `action` is `{ label, href, trailing? }` rendered as a small secondary button under the step.

examples.name: Default
